label: GOD_1 to root: the GOD_1-to-GOD_4 bridge gives the naming premise (transcription)
meaning: Transcription (single application): GOD_1 branch to the root premise. The naming premise in the NOMINAL sense is analytic, so all the content of the GOD_4 premise sits in the sense bridge: whatever meets the full nominal description is the God of classical theism. With NOMINAL-BRIDGE-FROM-GOD-NAMES the two are equivalent; the nominal reading adds no warrant.
